findings_for_the_m5_gate: F-A (HIGH, carried and now permanent until acted on): the report ships without its Escalated criterion. Five candidate column codes were rejected by the org (F-51) and no cited skill documents one, so it is a post-deploy runbook step - add 'Escalated = True' in the report builder and re-export, or harvest the code from a retrieved Case report. Written in deploy-order.md sections 0 and 2 U1, in an XML comment and in the report's 219-character description.

F-49 (HIGH, closed in the artefact, open at the skill): a Report <description> over 255 characters passes every checker and fails only at the org. admin/reports-and-dashboards has no Report description-length rule; the library's DESC family covers PermissionSet, Profile, CustomPermission and CustomObject.

F-50 (HIGH, closed in the artefact, open at the skill): the skill's worked report example gives reportType 'Cases' (rejected; CaseList is correct) and the owner grouping column 'USERS.NAME' (rejected; OWNER is correct), and nothing in it says a field may not be both a column and a grouping. All three are now proven live.

F-B (DOWNGRADED): the folder validated at its declared filename, so this is a checker-recognition gap in check_report_inventory.py, not a deploy defect. Deepening the checker to accept the bare <Folder>-meta.xml form is the better remedy; the alternative is a human read of the folder file at the gate.
Test-coverage finding: both declared checkers scored the org-rejected report 100 with zero findings and score it identically now - this step's automated gates say nothing about report correctness.

F-C (LOW, prose): acceptance_tests[0]'s step-scope exit-code claim is still wrong; the declared build-scope command is correct. F-D: decisions.md W02's stale check_queues.py reason, unchanged. F-E: no plan-level api_version; 67.0 read from the M3 gate's decision 6.
